items.prompt: A square courtyard has an area of 196 square metres. What is its perimeter in metres?
hints: The side length is the square root of 196.
14 × 14 = 196. Then use the side four times.
items.explanation: The side is √196 = 14 m. The perimeter is 4 × 14 = 56 m.

items.prompt: A cube-shaped box has a volume of 343 cubic centimetres. A cube has 12 edges. How many centimetres do all 12 edges add up to?
hints: Find the edge length of the cube.
What number multiplied by itself three times gives 343?
items.explanation: The edge is 7 cm because 7 × 7 × 7 = 343. The 12 edges add up to 12 × 7 = 84 cm.

items.prompt: Between which two whole numbers does √200 lie?
items.explanation: 14² = 196 is below 200 and 15² = 225 is above 200. So √200 is between 14 and 15.

options.why: This is 200 ÷ 2. A square root is much smaller than half.
